{{Top|leg}}
'''Alter Mind''' was a [[Force power/Legends|power]] archived in the [[Tedryn Holocron]] by [[Bodo Baas]]. It was the ability to shape the minds of others, and Baas believed this ability was useful, but could lead a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] down the path to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Alter Mind was also a term to describe the ability to project an image into the mind of another being. This image was often an altered perception of reality, but it could be an illusion that could influence the being.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
